attBesluta.text: Fonctionnal, strudy and light. I love it for ma garage!

Nice unit, bought the 1000lb model because my bikes are light and I want to work closer to the bike without the wider platform on the 1500lb model. Nice Red powder coat on everything. Easy build, took 15 minutes. Heavy unit, weighs 250lbs, get help to move. Unit with bike on it is very stable, even raised.
I got it so easy to put it together I'll be using it soon

Very nice piece, completely and professionally crafted on a pallet. Took less than a hour to put together. I would suggest you write the manual to include instructions that would include: that you have to get one end off the ground (It's simple I used a block of wood) to do step one. Also, and most importantly you need to include in the manual that you need to raise the lift in order to install the front wheel clamp etc... it's ridiculously easy to install. It's heavy so I would suggest having a friend nearby just in case. I should have bought one years ago. Thank you Vevor.
Très bon produit, facile à utiliser, montée rapide malgré le fait que ce soit au pied. Descente facile à maitriser. Rigide et pratique, je confirme que c'est un bon produit.
Dommage qu'il n'y ait pas de roulettes à la rampe d'accès. Sinon bon matos

Funny how "Title" is required. So, I put in a title. So, This motorcycle stand is one of the best purchases I've ever made. The set-up instructions are seriously lacking and in Chinglish So you either have to decipher it or figure it out yourself. I figured it out myself. That being said, I love this thing. It's inexpensive and just plain works. It does everything I need it to do (basically be a platform for my chopper building). I can already see that it's going to make maintenance much easier. I'm happy.
Sturding well built hydraulic jack 4 ton low profile 100%happy with this purchase. Will make short work for me in my busy garage.
